title: The Sign-Off That Signed Nothing
question: The Sign-Off That Signed Nothing
hook: Ask an AI to write your validation sign-off and you get a perfect one in one second — a name, a review, an approval — and every word of it is empty.
core_idea: An AI can generate the shape of accountability but not the substance, because a signature is a commitment by someone with stakes; the honest artifact is the attestation, whose load-bearing section is "what was NOT tested" — the one section the model can never write, because it doesn't know what it didn't do.
visual_object: A signature line under a sign-off paragraph that fills instantly but weighs nothing until the four attestation parts (tested / NOT tested / named human / calibrated verbs) stack under it.
exclusions: no five-requirements checklist walk-through, no cognitive tiers, no regulatory regimes, no answerability philosophy beyond one line ("a model doesn't lose its job").
